XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Monash Rubric Ranges

TABLE.NAME: gradingform_rubric_ranges_c
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the rows of the rubric grid.

FIELD.NAME: definitionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the form definition this criterion is part of

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Defines the order of the criterion in the rubric

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: The criterion description

FIELD.NAME: descriptionformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the description field

TABLE.NAME: gradingform_rubric_ranges_l
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the columns of the rubric grid.

FIELD.NAME: criterionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The rubric criterion we are level of

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: The score for this level

FIELD.NAME: definition
FIELD.COMMENT: The optional text describing the level

FIELD.NAME: definitionformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the definition field

TABLE.NAME: gradingform_rubric_ranges_f
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the data of how the rubric is filled by a particular rater

FIELD.NAME: instanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the grading form instance

FIELD.NAME: criterionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the criterion (row) in the rubric

FIELD.NAME: levelid
FIELD.COMMENT: If a particular level was selected during the assessment, its ID is stored here

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Actual grade value from selected range

FIELD.NAME: remark
FIELD.COMMENT: Side note feedback regarding this particular criterion

FIELD.NAME: remarkformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the remark field

INDEX.NAME: ix_levelid
INDEX.COMMENT: levelid acts as a foreign key but null values are allowed

TABLE.NAME: gradingform_rubric_ranges_w
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the weight of each criterion in the final grade

FIELD.NAME: criterionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The rubric criterion this weight belongs to

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative weight of the criterion (1-10)

TABLE.NAME: gradingform_rubric_ranges_h
TABLE.COMMENT: Validation history: original teacher filling replaced by a validator

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The graded item (grading_instances.itemid), stable across grading instances

FIELD.NAME: instanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The grading instance where the validation was saved

FIELD.NAME: criterionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The rubric criterion

FIELD.NAME: teacherlevelid
FIELD.COMMENT: Level selected by the teacher before the validation

FIELD.NAME: teachergrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade given by the teacher before the validation

FIELD.NAME: teacherremark
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback given by the teacher before the validation

FIELD.NAME: teacherremarkformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the teacher feedback

FIELD.NAME: teacherid
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who gave the original grade

FIELD.NAME: validatedlevelid
FIELD.COMMENT: Level resulting from the validation

FIELD.NAME: validatedgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade given by the validator

FIELD.NAME: validatedremark
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback given by the validator

FIELD.NAME: validatorid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who validated the grade

FIELD.NAME: timevalidated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the grade was validated

INDEX.NAME: uq_itemid_criterionid
INDEX.COMMENT: A grade can only be validated once

INDEX.NAME: ix_teacherlevelid
INDEX.COMMENT: teacherlevelid acts as a foreign key but null values are allowed

INDEX.NAME: ix_validatedlevelid
INDEX.COMMENT: validatedlevelid acts as a foreign key but null values are allowed
